title: Market Basket ABC
hook: Soft, leafy, firm, or spiny: handle the picture by its clues.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet before target
visualStyle: bright 3D produce-market storybook, neat baskets and stalls without readable signs, colorful isolated foods

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child identifying and handling market produce gently
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: structure/handling; no tasting or squeezing commands
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: handling cue -> recall beat -> target -> card-sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a marimba question-note and glockenspiel color-answer after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a marimba question-note and glockenspiel color-answer after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Market Basket ABC a handling-and-identification song: fragile, leafy, hard-root, stone-fruit, large-fruit and cactus produce require different storage/handling, without turning children into food-safety technicians.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sorts market produce by visible structure and gentle handling needs, with sharp/spiny items left to adults.
